name: Supercube-based Partial DMV
definition: A multiresolution representation that encodes nested tetrahedral meshes using supercubes as high-level primitives, exploiting spatial and hierarchical coherence to create sparse partial DMVs for isosurface extraction.
summary: Supercube-based partial DMV is a sparse volume representation that clusters diamonds into supercubes to significantly reduce storage overhead for isosurface extraction while maintaining performance comparable to diamond-based indexing.
